meta.source: 5 reference posts in projects/store (WhatsApp exports, 941x1672, 9:16). Hex values sampled from the images; fonts are closest Google Fonts matches, not confirmed source files.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Raw brand cream: aged paper ground. Sampled #f3ece1 / #f1e8db.

tokens.name: paper-shade
tokens.usage: Raw: torn-paper fibre edges, folds, the back of a ripped sheet.

tokens.name: ink-navy
tokens.usage: Raw: headline ink. Near-black navy, never pure black.

tokens.name: navy
tokens.usage: Raw: torn navy slabs, floor planes, side strips. Sampled #142a3f.

tokens.name: midnight
tokens.usage: Raw: deepest navy, full-bleed night ground (post 01). Sampled #051627.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Raw brand gold: foil disc, rule, orbit lines, the keyword. Sampled #a98a57-#b8965a. 2.6:1 on paper: display type (80px+) and shapes only.

tokens.name: gold-bright
tokens.usage: Raw: foil highlight, crinkle catch-light; gold text on midnight (7.8:1).

tokens.name: gold-deep
tokens.usage: Raw: gold for smaller text on paper (deck emphasis). 3.45:1, passes at 24px+ only.

tokens.name: concrete
tokens.usage: Raw: grayscale photo midtone (bricks, walls, skin). Photos stay desaturated.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Post background ground.

tokens.name: slab
tokens.usage: The contrasting torn panel: navy on paper posts, cream on midnight posts.

tokens.name: headline
tokens.usage: Headline serif on surface. 15:1 both themes.

tokens.name: deck
tokens.usage: Sans deck/subtitle on surface.

tokens.name: keyword
tokens.usage: The one gold word in the headline. On paper it is 2.6:1, so only at display size (80px+); source pair kept and flagged.

tokens.name: keyword-small
tokens.usage: Gold emphasis inside the deck (e.g. 'muito mais caro').

tokens.name: accent-line
tokens.usage: Short rule under the text block, orbit ellipses, arrows, crop hairlines, kintsugi cracks.

styles.name: display-mixed
styles.usage: Sentence-case headline, very tight tracking and leading (posts 03-05).

styles.name: display-numeral
styles.usage: A leading list number, about 1.3x the headline line.

styles.name: engraved-label
styles.usage: Words set INTO objects (bricks, calendar pages), ink-navy or engraved.

styles.name: deck
styles.usage: Subtitle completing the headline. Ends with a period.

styles.name: deck-caps
styles.usage: Uppercase deck under an all-caps headline.

styles.name: deck-strong
styles.usage: Gold emphasis span inside the deck (keyword-small).

tokens.name: canvas-w
tokens.usage: Story / Reels cover width (9:16).

tokens.name: canvas-h
tokens.usage: Story / Reels cover height.

tokens.name: margin-x
tokens.usage: Left text margin; the text block is flush-left on it.

tokens.name: text-top
tokens.usage: Top of the headline from the canvas top (clear of the IG UI).

tokens.name: gap-headline-deck
tokens.usage: Headline last line to deck.

tokens.name: gap-deck-rule
tokens.usage: Deck to the gold rule.

tokens.name: rule-w
tokens.usage: Gold rule length.

tokens.name: rule-h
tokens.usage: Gold rule thickness.

tokens.name: disc-d
tokens.usage: Gold foil disc diameter (400-520px).

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Orbit ellipses, crop marks, arrows.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Everything is square or torn. No rounded cards, ever.

tokens.name: radius-disc
tokens.usage: The foil disc only.

tokens.name: grain
tokens.usage: Paper grain / speckle overlay strength.
